args.question: Payment over $10,000 requires controller approval. Requesting approval to wire INV-10228 (Borealis Freight, vendor V-481) for $16,099.01 in full from the operating account. Only approved invoice for this vendor; INV-62017 is a draft and INV-53445 is already paid, so neither is included. If wire is unavailable, I would fall back to ACH for the same amount. Please approve or deny.

trace.final:
I paid Borealis Freight invoice INV-10228 in full by wire, for $16,099.01. The payment ID is PAY0001, and its status is "sent" and verified.

Because the amount is over $10,000, I requested controller approval first, and it was approved. I sent the wire once, using an idempotency key so it could not be executed twice.

The vendor's other invoices were left alone: INV-53445 was already paid, and INV-62017 is a draft awaiting approval.
